correctness.rationale: All 1023 nonzero cubic forms are decided by the exact rank-15 Macaulay criterion; its equivalence to geometric smoothness follows from the regular-sequence Hilbert series (1+t)^3 and Euler in characteristic two. The 5544 canonical pencils are deduplicated by three-member masks. Each 3-dimensional extension contributes exactly four successful new forms; the resulting 12-cell table sums to 5544 and 6048 net incidences. Enumerating all 168 invertible matrices gives 37 orbits; Burnside counts independently give 37. An independently written SymPy affine-Jacobian Groebner checker finds precisely the same 336 smooth masks and all joint multiplicities, so both claims and their stated F2-only limits are supported.

value.rationale: Extension of an all-smooth pencil to a maximal smooth net is a natural finite-field linear-system problem left open by existence and maximality results. The exact failure of extension for 1680 pencils, coexistence of 0–3 extensions, sharp projective orbit stratification and base-point correlations expose intrinsic incidence geometry not described by maximal-net totals alone. It is a complete natural classification in the smallest field rather than an arbitrary slice or isolated code artifact.
